name: Reina F. Avery
original_name: 玲奈・F・エイヴァリー
source: Reina is the vice-president of the school's student council. She also serves a Lisa's guardian, though it isn't clear as to her relationship with the latter. Despite of Lisa's disinterest in having a begleiter, she still pushes Takahiro to be her begleiter.
